CSV upload endpoint stores raw csv_columns and csv_rows for exact display
Summary metrics bar correctly extracts Clicks, Conversions, Revenue, Conv. Rate from CSV data
Legacy reports (without csv_columns) render in separate LegacyReportsTable component
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
